# DataQ

> DataQ — a single-tenant data-quality monitoring platform built on Great Expectations. User-friendly guides + developer references.

Every page below is available as raw Markdown at the linked `.md` URL. A curated subset
of them is also served to AI assistants by DataQ's MCP `get_doc` tool (its `page` enum
lists which).

## Home

- [Home](https://theurgicduke771.github.io/DataQ/docs/latest/latest/index.md): data — in Snowflake, ADLS Gen2, AWS S3 (or any S3-compatible store), Databricks Unity Catalog, and Apache Iceberg — tells you when

- [ADR 0003 — GX-only for v1; DQX deferred to v1.1 for DLT/streaming](https://theurgicduke771.github.io/DataQ/docs/latest/latest/adr/0003-gx-only-for-v1/index.md): DataQ v1 must run data quality checks across four datasource types: Snowflake, ADLS Gen2, AWS S3, and Unity Catalog (Databricks).
